We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (from make_8_lvl1-template_search-3) to the molecule given in make_8_lvl1-apply_template-2 answer: a list containing one SMILES: "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1". So target molecule is that SMILES.

We have template ID 1914397 and its mapped_rxn. Need to apply template to target molecule to get precursors. Use apply_template tool with molecule_smiles and template_id. Let's call apply_template.
